reason: A dsh plugin that packages 884 upstream Claude Code skill templates behind a model-invocable skill loader; the README documents broad workflow coverage and mixed per-directory licensing, so human review is appropriate.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 提供可按需加载的 Claude Code 技能模板目录，覆盖开发、研究、文档处理和自动化等多类工作流。
summaries.en: Provides dsh with an on-demand catalog of Claude Code skill templates covering development, research, document processing, automation, and other workflows.

capabilities: Provides a catalog of model-invocable skill instructions
Loads selected skills on demand through the dsh skill tool
Includes skill-related references, examples, and assets
Supports workflows spanning development, research, document processing, and automation
